source: gpurentalprices API; reuse v19 immutable captures without altering v19 protocol
target: Exact individual provider contract quote; new source IDs, no identity claim with competition medians
cohort: Same deterministic first eligible v19 source-specific 8–12-contract cohort, frozen before forecasts; no replacements
selection: Head checkpoint selected only on reused development seven-day pinball with update zero eligible. Both equal-weight ensembles retained; no retrospective weight fitting.
primary_comparison: Selected head versus unchanged frozen v19 price/17; paired seven-day mean dollar pinball
secondary_comparisons: selected head versus development-selected fixed ensemble
median MAE, coverage, width, failures and inference costs
model_lock: Commit selected checkpoint/resource-identity hash, tokenizer, protocol and engine hashes before first eligible issuance; private paths excluded
truth: First retained compatible target-date snapshot from registered capture window, after maturity; retain revisions separately
publication: Signed GitHub Actions/Sigstore commitment manifest covering exact issued forecast bytes; verified timestamp must precede registered deadline and outcome resolution

analysis.interim: Descriptive only; no promotion or repeated significance testing
analysis.resampling: Paired origin-block sensitivity lengths 2 and 4, 2000 repetitions, seed20261117; common market shocks remain dependent
analysis.promotion: At fixed analysis, positive evidence only if selected head has lower paired loss versus both frozen parent and selected ensemble, paired block upper95% bound below zero under both sensitivities, and no higher failure rate. Otherwise inconclusive/negative; do not extend until it wins.
analysis.duration_caution: 16 origins are a bounded initial panel, not a power guarantee; no prospective claim before outcomes mature

fallback: Persistence with explicit failure flag; absent compatible current contract or failed provenance prevents issuance, absent truth stays pending
